summary: Regression testing completed for Staff BioTime + executable approval queue + privacy + auth hardening. Staff mobile/BioTime and admin-accessed merchant security UI passed. Backend found 2 auth/security regressions and approval-flow retest was partially blocked by API rate limiting.

critical.issue: Preflight responds with access-control-allow-origin='*' while credentials are enabled; explicit origin expected for cookie auth.
Brute-force behavior does not match required contract 'lockout after 5 failed attempts'; observed early 429 sequence [401,401,401,429,429,429].

minor.issue: Regression tests were skipped in final full run due transient 429 rate limiting on merchant login (retry_after=60).

ui_bugs.component: Merchant Dashboard access with merchant credential
ui_bugs.issue: Security tab check blocked by KYC gate for haendler@bidblitz.ae during UI run; merchant-tab-security selector unavailable in this state.

action_items: Fix CORS behavior for credentialed requests so allow-origin is explicit (not wildcard).
Align auth lockout threshold to requirement (trigger strictly after 5 failed attempts).
Re-run approval execution/privacy backend tests after rate-limit cooldown to confirm no regression.
If merchant KYC gate remains expected, keep admin-based security-tab smoke in CI and add deterministic merchant test account state for QA.
critical_code_review_comments: staff_biotime_status/enroll/clock endpoints correctly keep _id/template_token_encrypted/token_fingerprint out of public responses.
Approval queue frontend uses masking helper and avoids rendering obvious raw email/balance fields in tested state.
Auth/CORS hardening expectations are not fully met in deployed response headers/lockout behavior.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Staff mobile login via /staff/mobile with PIN 1234 works and BioTime tab renders. Staff BioTime backend status/enroll/clock passed with privacy checks. Merchant security UI is reachable and approval panel renders under admin session; merchant credential run was KYC-gated. Backend approval execution tests were previously passing in run #2 but skipped in final full run due temporary 429 rate-limit on merchant login, so rerun after cooldown.
rca of the issue: 1) CORS: Deployed preflight response returns wildcard origin while credentials are allowed, likely from outer CORS layer/ingress policy overriding app-level explicit origin. 2) Lockout: Login attempt counter/lock transition appears to lock earlier than specified threshold; verify MAX_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS handling and state update path. 3) Test skip cause: high request volume triggered API rate limiter on merchant login, preventing final approval regression assertions in same run.
